name: Karthik
headline: Forward Deployed Engineer · AI / ML Systems
summary: I turn a client's messy business problem into an AI system that can actually run in their environment. I work from the requirement document to the architecture, data model, agent design, security controls, capacity plan and cost model — and I keep every number traceable. My recent work covers agentic investigation platforms on AWS (LangGraph, RAG, knowledge graphs, LLM gateways) and domain-specific LLMs fine-tuned and served under tight latency and compliance limits.

focusAreas.title: Client problem → architecture
focusAreas.text: Read the requirement document, separate MUST from SHOULD, and design a system whose every component traces back to a requirement and an acceptance test.

focusAreas.title: Agents & RAG that are safe to deploy
focusAreas.text: Bounded LangGraph agents with tool budgets, citation verification, quarantined readers for untrusted text and human approval before any side effect.

focusAreas.title: LLMs under real constraints
focusAreas.text: Fine-tuning, distillation and quantisation to hit latency, cost and data-residency targets — measured against a baseline the model must beat.

focusAreas.title: Capacity, cost and operations
focusAreas.text: Demand models, GPU and data-store sizing, managed-vs-self-hosted break-even analysis, SLOs, DR and observability.
